title: Integral bounds for a power tail
statement:
For every real number $s<-1$ and every natural number $q$, the integral of $(2x+1)^s$ over $x>q+1$ is at most the series of its values at the odd integers beginning with $2q+3$, and that series is at most the integral over $x>q$; explicitly,
\[\int_{q+1}^{\infty}(2x+1)^s\,dx\leq\sum_{r=0}^{\infty}(2(r+q+1)+1)^s\leq\int_q^{\infty}(2x+1)^s\,dx.\]
